name: Exec Cluster E05: Kelly Criterion Half-Kelly Sizing
description: Tests: kelly half-Kelly sizing with crossover signals
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: Kelly Criterion Dynamic Sizing
# Tests: E05 (kelly with fraction=0.5)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: Simple EMA crossover ===
fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)

is_bullish = fast > slow
is_bearish = fast < slow

held_long = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=is_bearish, exit=is_bullish)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# E05: Half-Kelly sizing (conservative)
kelly(fraction=0.5, min_trades=20, fallback_pct=10)

# Fixed stop for risk control
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=8)
